cases.reason: No Rocket-capable FP16 builder emits and validates CNA_PAD_CON0. conv_new_clean.py comments the pad register out (lines 547-550) and computes valid-only geometry. conv_mesa_fp16.py does emit CNA_PAD_CON0, but its register path is the Mesa uint8 zero-point semantics (for example BS_OW_OP uses 0x80 - weights_zero_point and OUT_CVT/EW scales are quantized), so using it would change the numerical contract. A true pad-register FP16 case is therefore blocked pending source evidence and tests. The READY padded case uses an explicit zero frame instead.

cases.description: Split-K reduction convolution, where partial K tiles would be summed.
cases.reason: Split-K reduction requires accumulation of partial products across tiles. Neither inspected Rocket path provides an accumulator or a second reduction pass: conv_0522._execute_conv_tiles clears the output BO before every tile and _tile_to_desc leaves all tile offsets at zero; conv_new_clean has no K-split for spatial conv. Only split-OC is encoded as READY. Adding split-K would require a new accumulation contract, not just more tasks.
